summary: All 5 files contain formal mathematical definitions, theorems, and proofs about Matrix Product Unitaries (MPU) in the TNLean library. Equivalence.lean defines strict equivalence, equivalence under symmetry, and stabilized equivalence with supporting theorems. SwapBlockedSymmetryTransport.lean and SwapSymmetryTransport.lean formalize symmetry transport via the physical swap, with blocked and unblocked variants. SourceUCompleteNetwork.lean and SourceVIsometry.lean formalize the source gate isometry proofs and dressed Gram equations from arXiv:1703.09188. None are pure import aggregators; all contain substantial formal mathematics with proofs.
